# Payment, Error-State and Access-Control Requirements Quality Checklist: Workshop OTA Connectivity

**Date created**: 2026-11-15
**Date updated**: 2026-11-15
**Author**: Hồ Hoàng Quốc
**Last updated by**: Hồ Hoàng Quốc

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of payment/refund edge cases, OTA error and recovery states, and access control/data exposure. Session 2026-11-15 clarifications are treated as decided; open tasks T123-T129 and the VNPay QueryDR gap (T046) are not counted as defects.
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.


## Payment & refund edge cases

- [ ] CHK001 Is the expected net payout of a booking defined as targetNetAmount x participant count N, in the price terms' currency, snapshotted at confirmation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Clarifications Q1]
  - Assessment: PASS - Q1 fixes the formula, currency and snapshot moment; FR-014/T110 consume it.
- [ ] CHK002 Is it specified whether the expected net changes when k of N participants are cancelled by a confirmed partial cancellation? [Gap, Spec §FR-011, §FR-014]
  - Assessment: FAIL - Q3 revokes k tickets, but no requirement says whether expected net is recomputed or only a linked Manager adjustment is made (US4 says refunds/fees do not silently change the receivable).
- [ ] CHK003 Is the reconciliation currency rule unambiguous when the payout actually received is in a different currency than the price terms? [Ambiguity, Clarifications Q2]
  - Assessment: FAIL - Q2 equates "price terms' currency" with "the payout actually received"; the case where they differ is not defined (reject, convert, dispute).
- [ ] CHK004 Are FX-variance recording criteria (when a difference is variance vs mismatch, sign, rounding, tolerance) defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
  - Assessment: FAIL - FR-015 lists FX variance as a ledger kind and Q2 says conversion differences are adjustments; no threshold or rule separates variance from a dispute.
- [ ] CHK005 Is the customer-paid amount/currency stated as evidence-only and never used to match a payout or to reject a booking? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Clarifications Q2]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-012 amendment and Q2 are explicit.
- [ ] CHK006 Is the trigger for recording PARTIALLY_REFUNDED stated (only when the OTA reports it, never derived by Mland)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-012 and Q3.
- [ ] CHK007 Are valid transitions among REFUND_REQUESTED, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED and REFUNDED (order, later full refund, repeat partials, regression) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
  - Assessment: FAIL - FR-012 lists the four states only; no transition or cumulative-amount rule exists in spec, data-model or contract.
- [ ] CHK008 Is the distinction between a cancellation request and a confirmed outcome defined, including that a request revokes nothing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §US3-AC1]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-011, US3 AC1/AC2, Q3.
- [ ] CHK009 Is the fixed rule for choosing k tickets to revoke defined when k exceeds the number of not-yet-checked-in tickets but is below active tickets? [Ambiguity, Clarifications Q3]
  - Assessment: FAIL - Q3 orders "not yet checked in first, then highest sequence" but does not say whether an already checked-in ticket may be revoked, nor how that squares with "never rewrite attendance history" and SC-003 "unused tickets".
- [ ] CHK010 Are the k boundaries non-overlapping (k equal to active tickets, k greater than active tickets)? [Conflict, Clarifications Q3]
  - Assessment: FAIL - Q3 says k "at least the active tickets" cancels the whole booking, and also that k "exceeds the active tickets" opens a work item; the k > active case is covered by both outcomes.
- [ ] CHK011 Is the effect of a customer refund or fee on the supplier receivable separated from the customer-payment record? [Consistency, Spec §US4, §FR-016]
  - Assessment: PASS - US4 narrative: refund/fee recorded only as a linked Manager adjustment; FR-016 append-only correction.
- [ ] CHK012 Is it stated that Mland sends no email/SMS to an OTA customer on cancellation, and what the outbound OTA notification means? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Clarifications Q4]
  - Assessment: PASS - Q4 is explicit.

## Error/failure states & recovery

- [ ] CHK013 Is the retry schedule (attempt count, spacing basis, time of attempt 1, relation to the 30 s worker poll, "under 15 minutes") unambiguous? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017, Clarifications Q7]
  - Assessment: FAIL - Q7 gives 3 attempts at 30 s / 2 min / 10 min "under 15 minutes in total" (sums to 12.5 min) but not whether spacing is from the previous failure or the first send, nor how the 30 s poll interval maps to it; T105 (3 attempts, 30 s poll) differs from Q7 pending T127.
- [ ] CHK014 Is the consequence of exhausted outbound retry scoped to the affected mapping only, with audit and a work item? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004c, §FR-017]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-004c, FR-017, Q7.
- [ ] CHK015 Is handling of a booking arriving for a closed or suspended mapping defined (reject, no capacity, audited case, no auto-move)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004d]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-004d.
- [ ] CHK016 Are duplicate booking deliveries required to return the original result with no second booking, ticket, capacity or financial effect? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §SC-001]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-007, US1 AC2, SC-001.
- [ ] CHK017 Are the inbound dedupe key and the same-reference/different-payload conflict rule specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, A1]
  - Assessment: PASS - A1 decision 2026-11-14 defines the key, conflict refusal and INBOUND_EVENT work item.
- [ ] CHK018 Is the ordering criterion for out-of-order or late provider events (what makes an event late; allowed kind sequences) defined? [Gap, Spec §US3-AC3]
  - Assessment: FAIL - US3 AC3 requires safety for "late, out-of-order" callbacks but the spec gives no ordering key or kind state machine; only task T108 describes one case.
- [ ] CHK019 Are failure outcomes of the cancellation-events ingress (unmappable body, unknown booking, unmapped event, replay) specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, Clarifications Q3]
  - Assessment: PASS - Contract: 200 with outcome, 422 with work-item reference, replay returns stored outcome; Q3 lists work-item triggers.
- [ ] CHK020 Are response codes and bodies for ingress authentication failures defined consistently (blank/unresolvable reference, wrong signature, unapproved production provider)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022, Interim ingress]
  - Assessment: FAIL - Only "403 in PRODUCTION for unapproved provider" is explicit; the status for a wrong signature or unresolvable reference is not stated (401 vs 403) in spec or contract.
- [ ] CHK021 Is idempotent revocation of a partial cancellation per OTA event stated? [Completeness, Spec §SC-003, Clarifications Q5]
  - Assessment: PASS - Q5 says idempotent per OTA event; SC-003 repeats it.

## Access control & data exposure

- [ ] CHK022 Is OTA callback authentication specified as fail-closed in every environment, with constant-time comparison and TEST-token limits? [Completeness, Spec §Interim ingress, D1]
  - Assessment: PASS - Interim ingress text, D1, contract booking-events row.
- [ ] CHK023 Is the storage of the bearer secret specified (non-secret lookup name in MySQL, value in secret channel, never logged or returned)? [Clarity, Spec §D1, Plan Constitution check]
  - Assessment: PASS - D1 decided 2026-11-14.
- [ ] CHK024 Are secret rotation, replay protection (timestamp/nonce) and revocation of the shared ingress secret addressed or explicitly deferred? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
  - Assessment: FAIL - A static header secret is compared with no rotation, expiry or replay-window requirement, and the scheme is not an approved signature; only per-provider onboarding is deferred.
- [ ] CHK025 Is the Admin versus Manager authority split defined for connection/credentials, business sync/reconciliation and financial evidence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004b, §FR-004b1]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-004b/004b1 and plan identity row.
- [ ] CHK026 Is the list of Admin "technical/recovery actions across locations" enumerated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004b]
  - Assessment: FAIL - FR-004b says "its authorized technical/recovery actions" without listing them or their boundary against Manager actions.
- [ ] CHK027 Is Staff access to OTA financial evidence and payout reconciliation explicitly denied or defined? [Gap, Spec §FR-004b1]
  - Assessment: FAIL - FR-004b1 grants Manager only; Staff is silent in spec, contract and plan, so denial is only implied.
- [ ] CHK028 Are the unassigned/out-of-scope Staff responses consistent with the stated non-disclosure of booking existence? [Conflict, Spec §Staff booking-assignment access, Plan Identity row]
  - Assessment: FAIL - Lookup answers as if missing (404) but the add-on quote refuses with 403 for the same booking id; plan says existence must not be exposed to unauthorized actors.
- [ ] CHK029 Is authorization required to derive from active Mland authority server-side, not from OTA claims, display role or UI? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §FR-004b]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-021, FR-004b.
- [ ] CHK030 Are PII, credential and token exposure limits specified for logs, audit and OTA failure views? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §FR-018, §SC-006]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-010, FR-018, SC-006.
- [ ] CHK031 Is a safe typed, correlation-linked error requirement stated for all OTA failures? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
  - Assessment: PASS - FR-022 plus contract standard responses.

## Cross-feature consistency (facade with 003.1 / 003.2 / 003.3)

- [ ] CHK032 Is the 003.2 operation that revokes named OTA tickets (callable only by 003.4, idempotent per OTA event) documented in the shared facade contract? [Consistency, Clarifications Q5, Facades contract]
  - Assessment: FAIL - workshop-interfeature-facades.md lists only whole-booking applyVerifiedRefundConsequence and cancelBooking; no k-ticket OTA revocation row exists.
- [ ] CHK033 Is 003.2 FR-036's refusal of general ticket operations for OTA tickets reconciled with the new OTA-only operation? [Consistency, Clarifications Q5]
  - Assessment: PASS - Q5 states FR-036 still refuses other callers and the new operation is 003.4-only.
- [ ] CHK034 Is ownership of the refund of an OTA add-on bill (003.3 bank refund, no Staff or gateway refund) consistent across 003.3/003.4? [Consistency, Spec §Staff booking-assignment access, Facades contract]
  - Assessment: PASS - Restatement 2026-11-14 and SHOP_ADDON facade row.
- [ ] CHK035 Is the Staff booking-assignment check defined as a read-only facade query shared with 003.3? [Consistency, Facades contract isStaffAssignedToBooking]
  - Assessment: PASS - Facade row for isStaffAssignedToBooking and plan identity row.
- [ ] CHK036 Does the contract's cancellation-events description agree with the decided partial-cancellation behaviour? [Conflict, Contract cancellation-events, Clarifications Q3]
  - Assessment: FAIL - The contract's cancellation-events row still says "V1 cancels the whole booking", while Q3 and the contract's own cancelTicket note describe k-ticket revocation.

## Acceptance criteria measurability

- [ ] CHK037 Does a success criterion cover expected net = target net x N and currency-correct reconciliation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Clarifications Q1/Q2]
  - Assessment: FAIL - SC-004 only requires four totals to stay distinct; no SC or acceptance scenario measures the N multiplication or FX variance handling.
- [ ] CHK038 Is there a measurable criterion for the retry schedule and for rejecting unauthenticated callbacks? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..SC-006]
  - Assessment: FAIL - No SC covers retry timing/exhaustion closure or 100% rejection of unauthenticated/unapproved callbacks.
- [ ] CHK039 Is SC-003's "revoke only applicable unused tickets" consistent with the Q3 fixed-rule partial revocation? [Conflict, Spec §SC-003, Clarifications Q3]
  - Assessment: FAIL - SC-003 says unused tickets only; Q3's rule can revoke by sequence and does not state a checked-in exclusion.
- [ ] CHK040 Is the redaction success criterion testable as a pass/fail percentage? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
  - Assessment: PASS - SC-006 states 100% redaction in failure log/audit views.

### Re-assessment (2026-11-15, agent, not a reviewer approval)

*Appended after the owner decisions of Hồ Hoàng Quốc, 2026-11-15 (spec.md "Checklist follow-up (payment-error-access.md), answered 2026-11-15") and the documentation sync. The assessments and totals above are the original ones and are unchanged; no box is ticked. "Now meets the requirement level" means the written requirement answers the item's question; it does not mean the code is done (tasks T123–T125, T127, T132–T144 are open) and it is not ratification, which the reviewer owns. Confirmed by Hồ Hoàng Quốc on 2026-11-15: the 003.2 error and access conventions apply to 003.4 (`409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`, `503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE` fail-closed, test token only for an `ACTIVE` `TEST` connection, audit of a refused sensitive attempt), and the FR-011 transition table is accepted, including its two rows for a refund while the booking is `OPEN`/`CANCELLATION_REQUESTED` and for a second confirmed-cancellation event after `CANCELLED`.*

- CHK002: Now meets the requirement level. Expected net stays `targetNetAmount × N` after a partial or whole-booking cancellation and the Manager records an evidenced `ADJUSTMENT` (spec "Checklist follow-up" CHK002, US4 paragraph, FR-016, SC-007; data-model `ota_payout_positions`).
- CHK003: Now meets the requirement level. Price terms and `BANK_RECEIPT` are both in VND and a `BANK_RECEIPT` in another currency opens a dispute (follow-up CHK003, US4, contract payout-reconciliation row). The statement that Klook pays Mland in VND is the owner's and still has to be checked against the real contract.
- CHK004: Now meets the requirement level. V1 has no FX variance; every payout difference is a dispute closed by an evidenced `ADJUSTMENT` (follow-up CHK004, FR-015, Q2 superseded, US4 AC3, data-model ledger kinds; T124).
- CHK007: Now meets the requirement level. The transition table in FR-011, the append-only no-summing rule, `REFUNDED` final and the late-event handling in FR-012 answer the item; refund events release no ticket (follow-up CHK007; data-model `ota_customer_payment_evidence`).
- CHK009: Now meets the requirement level. A checked-in ticket is never revoked, only not-yet-checked-in tickets are chosen, and k above the not-yet-checked-in tickets revokes nothing and opens an `INBOUND_EVENT` work item (follow-up CHK009, Q3 amended, FR-011, SC-003, shared facade row). Enforcement needs the 003.2 operation (003.2 T123), not yet built.
- CHK010: Now meets the requirement level. The boundaries no longer overlap: k equal to the active tickets cancels the whole booking, k above them revokes nothing and opens a work item (follow-up CHK010, Q3 amended, FR-011); k is the event's own count (follow-up "k", T142).
- CHK013: Now meets the requirement level. One initial send plus 3 retries, 30 s / 2 min / 10 min after the previous failure, first send at the first poll, last send about 14.5 minutes after the first including the poll (Q7 clarified, follow-up CHK013, FR-017, SC-009, plan Performance Goals, data-model `next_attempt_at`); the `SALES_CLOSE` control command follows the same schedule (T134, T135).
- CHK018: Now meets the requirement level. Events are applied in order received through the one-way `OPEN` → `CANCELLATION_REQUESTED` → `CANCELLED` → `REFUNDED` states, a backward event is refused as late with an audit entry and no work item, and an unknown booking opens an `INBOUND_EVENT` work item (follow-up CHK018, US3 AC3, FR-011 table). Ordering by the OTA's own timestamp is deliberately not used until T004.
- CHK020: Now meets the requirement level. `401` for a missing or wrong signature, a blank or unresolvable reference or no `ACTIVE` connection, `403` only for an unapproved `PRODUCTION` provider, with the safe body (spec "Interim provider booking ingress", FR-010, FR-022, contract rows, OpenAPI descriptions, SC-008).
- CHK024: Now meets the requirement level, as an explicit deferral. Rotation, revocation and replay protection are stated for the interim ingress, and a signature with timestamp, nonce, replay window and key rotation is a go-live condition per provider (follow-up CHK024, FR-010, provider-readiness "Callback authentication").
- CHK026: Now meets the requirement level, by removal. Admin has no authority and no REST route in 003.4, and the Manager actions are listed (FR-004b, FR-004b1, C2, follow-up CHK026, contract rows, OpenAPI). Code is T138 and T139.
- CHK027: Now meets the requirement level. Staff, including assigned Staff, and Admin get `403` before the booking is looked up (FR-004b1, contract rows, OpenAPI descriptions).
- CHK028: Now meets the requirement level. The lookup answers `404`, the quote, acceptance and direct-bill routes take an opaque UUID and answer `403` (FR-022, contract non-disclosure paragraph, plan identity row, OpenAPI `NotFound` and `Forbidden`).
- CHK032: Now meets the requirement level. The shared facade contract has a "Revoke named tickets of an OTA booking" row for the 003.2 operation, marked planned (003.2 T123), including that it refuses a checked-in ticket.
- CHK036: Now meets the requirement level. The cancellation-events row of the contract and its OpenAPI description now describe the k-ticket revocation rule; no document still says that V1 cancels the whole booking except as struck history.
- CHK037: Now meets the requirement level. SC-007 measures `targetNetAmount × N` (N = 1 and N = 3), the unchanged expected net, VND reconciliation and the dispute on a difference; verified by T123 and T143.
- CHK038: Now meets the requirement level. SC-008 covers unauthenticated and unapproved callbacks and SC-009 the retry schedule, exhaustion closure and the single open work item; verified by T143.
- CHK039: Now meets the requirement level. SC-003 is rewritten to revoke only not-yet-checked-in tickets, never change a checked-in ticket or attendance history, be idempotent per OTA event and audit the revoked tickets.

**New tally (agent re-assessment, 2026-11-15):** 40 of 40 items meet the requirement level (the original 22 PASS plus the 18 items above), 0 still missing; 0 boxes ticked, so the reviewer's ratification is still pending for all 40. Residual points that are not checklist failures: the owner's statements on Klook VND settlement and cancellation deadlines are unverified against the real contracts (T004), the names `RETRYING` (control outbox waiting state), `next_attempt_at` and `retry_count` (at most 3) are confirmed by Hồ Hoàng Quốc on 2026-11-15 (added by a new migration, renamable if a suitable column exists), and the 003.2 operation name is fixed by 003.2 T123.
